find_stacklund.Text: Where can I find Mr. Stacklund?

survived.Text: Yes. We were lucky to survive. I'm still shaken up.

learn.Text: Yeah, I think I need to learn my way around if I'm to survive this planet.

who_else.Text: Who else on this island do I talk to?

help_out.Text: Maybe I could help you out?

what_do.Text: Ok, what do you want me to do, then?

find_molen.Text: Where can I find Travis Molen?

find_stacklund2.Text: Where can I find Antonio Stacklund?

anything_else.Text: Anything else I can do for you?

who_next.Text: Who should I talk to next?

handin_parts.Text: I have the parts and a weapon right here.

who.Text: Name's Adri. You one of the people on the shuttle that just hammered down on the beach?

shaken.Text: A shuttle crash will have that effect on you. So, I take it you've found your way around a little. Suppose you'd like something to do?

good_idea.Text: Good idea. Well, there's a number of people on the island you could help out. Usually, they'll compensate you for your time. Why do you think I've stayed behind even after the aliens landed?

people.Text: There's always Travis Molen up in the main compound. He could always do with an extra pair of hands. Or, if you just want to get rid of some stuff you've found, talk to Antonio Stacklund.

molen.Text: Go through the snippet of tunnel behind me and up the ramp. Continue past the soldiers and up on top. You'll see him. Bald fella, big moustache.

stacklund.Text: Go through the snippet of tunnel behind me and up the ramp. Continue past the soldiers and up on top. He's usually talking to some customers. Nice fellow.

droids.Text: Sure. See the docks down there? A shipment of cargo droids and waste collectors went nuts after the fuses in their transport crates blew. Must've short circuited their chip brains or something.

Text: Anyway, I have some..business..down there, but they go postal on me if I go near the crates I need to get to.

{delay 2}{givequest DAD0}Just clear out a few of the droids, waste buckets and the two larger droids that guard the piers, will you? Here, I've uploaded the details to your NCU. Come back when you've decommissioned a few of them and I'll pay you for the trouble. I'll even throw in a backpack for you since I'm such a nice guy.

busy_droids.Text: Just clear out a few of the droids, waste buckets and the two larger droids that guard the piers, will you? Come back when you've decommissioned a few of them and I'll pay you for the trouble.

after_droids.Text: Great news, friend. Here, take these credits and the backpack I promised you. You've been a good help.

Text: I dabble a little in amateur weapon technology and I've found a way to overclock the weapon stocks here on the island.
{delay 2}\nI already have some good weapons in stock, but I need some components to build more.\n

{delay 1}{givequest DAPR}Here, I'll upload a list of things I need. Bring me the items, and I'll issue you with a better boomstick. Or just stick. Or bow or whatever you want to use. All the details you need to know are in the briefing. Return to me, and I'll pay you for the work and give you a new weapon.
The list is: a Power Supply (Cargo Droid), a Compression Chamber (Waste Collector), Bone Plates (Cliff Malle), Stalker Limbs (Tropical Stalker), Rollerrat Intestines (Rollerrat) and a basic weapon.
{delay 1}If you don't have a weapon, you can buy one from Antonio Stacklund.

handin_parts.Text: Let's see them. Put all five parts and the weapon you want upgraded in the trade window.{opentrade}

done_all.Text: Hey there. That weapon treating you well?
